## Flagship course: MPPR

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Modelling for Pandemic Preparedness and Response"}
I am the **lead facilitator** for the Modelling for Pandemic Preparedness and Response (MPPR) modular short course, hosted by the [German–West African Centre for Global Health and Pandemic Prevention (G-WAC)](https://g-wac.org/) at the College of Health Sciences, Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology (KNUST), Kumasi, Ghana. Two cohorts have been delivered, in 2024 and 2025.

**By the end of the course, participants can:**

- Understand the concepts of infectious disease transmission and control
- Access, curate, and reason about data sources in (West) Africa
- Design, implement, and use context-specific mathematical models in R
- Communicate modelling output effectively
- Join a network of disease modellers focused on West Africa
:::

## What I teach

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
::: {.feature-card}
[Infectious disease modelling]{.card-title-text}

- Compartmental models and estimating the basic reproduction number ([materials](https://jamesmbaazam.github.io/intro-to-idd-modelling/))
- Model fitting techniques ([materials](https://jamesmbaazam.github.io/mppr_intro_to_model_fitting/#/title-slide))
- Branching process models for early outbreaks
- Bayesian models for infectious disease forecasting
- Generative Bayesian forecasting models
- Forecast evaluation with proper scoring rules
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
::: {.feature-card}
[Reproducible workflows]{.card-title-text}

- R programming, from basics to advanced (package development, OOP)
- Research software and code development best practices
- Git and GitHub, from basics to merging, rebasing, and cherry-picking
- R package development to industry standards
- Pipeline orchestration with [GNU make](https://www.gnu.org/software/make/) and [targets](https://books.ropensci.org/targets/)
- Reproducible environments with [Docker](https://www.docker.com/) and [renv](https://rstudio.github.io/renv/)
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
::: {.feature-card}
[Evidence synthesis & writing]{.card-title-text}

- Systematic and scoping review methods
- Free automation tools such as Rayyan ([tutorials](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wyybhi4iL_M&list=PL_JK9Yk5mzB5sz8TIqv8dat5pf-ouMeyK))
- Thesis and journal article writing techniques
:::
:::
